satirical_subtitle: Not Recommended For Those Prone To Introspection

visual_design.exterior_description: Hidden behind glowing green velvet curtain in Absinthe Arcade's north end. Vapor seeps under curtain, swirls in impossible patterns defying physics. Small weathered plaque: 'Not recommended for those prone to introspection'
visual_design.interior_description: Single warped-perspective room with mirror portals creating maze-like navigation. Bar shaped like cracked absinthe bottle constantly dripping glowing liquid into void. Floating candlelight with no visible source. Portraits on walls that sometimes blink. Fog-drenched floors creating depth illusions.

satirical_design.theme_description: Surrealist absinthe den where gravity feels inconsistent, rooms bend at impossible angles, and every surface reflects a version of yourself you don't recognize - tourist trap meets existential crisis
satirical_design.primary_satirical_focus: Prague's absinthe mystique commercialized into manufactured psychedelic experiences for tourists

buffoon_delusion.what_bros_think: Experiencing authentic absinthe-induced hallucinations in underground European den
buffoon_delusion.what_actually_happening: Theatrical brewery dungeon with mirror tricks and fog machines exploiting tourist expectations

core_mechanics.description: Warped-perspective room with mirror portals creating maze-like navigation. Some mirrors teleport to different room sections, others confuse control inputs
Player's own sprite mirrored and distorted. Must defeat within 3 turns or Confused status applied
core_mechanics.dialogue: You ever think maybe you're the problem, bro?

core_mechanics.description: Boss that splits into illusions. Identify real Wisp among illusions, manage Confused status applications

intro_cutscene.text: You peel back the glowing green curtain… and the vapor hits your face like regret in your 30s.

satirical_subtitle: We Don't Serve Beer — We Inhale It

visual_design.exterior_description: Hidden beneath Clocktower Plaza accessible via concealed switch. Large metal vault door marked with neon graffiti and countdown glyphs showing midnight activation. Faint thumping bass pulses from within. Neon glow seeps around door edges.
visual_design.interior_description: Cyberpunk basement with central brewing vats doubling as massive subwoofers. Neon piping floor-to-ceiling creating grid patterns. Fermentation chambers with circuit boards and LED displays. RGB lights flickering like software crash. Vapor clouds suspended creating atmospheric depth. Everything rhythm-reactive: lights pulse, steam bursts, NPC movement syncs to beat.

satirical_design.theme_description: Experimental vapor-brewed lagers served as vape clouds in a nightclub rendered by a GPU having a breakdown - where pretentious craft brewery culture meets cyberpunk tech-bro vapor culture

core_mechanics.description: Press buttons synced to glitchy techno track to maintain beer vapor pressure. Match button presses to rhythm indicators scrolling across fermentation chambers.
CRT monitor head with floating ad banner drones. Random item removed from inventory if not stunned quickly.
Boss using rhythm and audio as weapons. Dodge sound-wave attacks timed to music beat, counter during vulnerable phases.

intro_cutscene.text: A bass drop echoes as the vault creaks open. You step into what feels like a nightclub inside a GPU.

visual_design.exterior_description: Hidden entrance down graffiti-laced alley behind opera house ruins billboard. Heavy velvet curtain as only door, subtly pulsating with music bass. Cybernetic-eyed bouncer guards velvet-rope checkpoint with glowing sign: '✨ Vibes Only. No Shoes? No Dignity? You're In.' Graffiti dumpster mural, distant glitchy lounge-techno bass, dead-end service lane contrasts opulent interior reveal.

Gold-plated stripper poles serving as coat racks. DJ dais shaped like broken throne. Deep burgundy fog machines creating atmosphere. Neon signs with cryptic phrases. VIP bathroom behind 'Staff Only' curtain. RGB LED shimmer throughout. Bass-pulsating ambience.

satirical_subtitle: Brewvolution™ - Your Mouth Is Now Under Analysis

visual_design.exterior_description: Inside Velvet Curtain Club, past dance floor toward restrooms. Staff Only velvet rope with glowing QR code pad embedded in door frame. Holographic sign flickers 'B.R.E.W. Lab - Authorized Personnel Only' in neon blue. Door emits faint server fan hum, cold LED light leaking from crack. Surveillance camera shaped like beer tap rotates toward you with motorized whir.
visual_design.interior_description: L-shaped basement lab. Left: glass brewing vats with bioluminescent green bubbling, labeled with blockchain addresses. Right: AI control consoles with holographic displays. Robotic bartender tap-dances on ceiling rails between flavor stations. Sleek white floor panels with embedded LED pathways pulsing to algorithm timing. Stainless steel fermentation tanks with USB ports and ethernet cables duct-taped to sides. Failed startup posters ('Disrupt the Thirst™'). Holographic beer labels changing based on crypto market fluctuations. Decommissioned mining rigs repurposed as bottle warmers. Every 10 seconds robotic voice interjects buzzword ('Optimizing!', 'Blockchain verified!', 'Synergy achieved!').

satirical_design.theme_description: Failed crypto startup pivots to AI-optimized craft brewing after ICO collapse. Everything over-engineered: beers brewed by machine learning analyzing crypto trends, blockchain-verified batches, NFT art dictating flavors. Retrofuturistic aesthetic where clean tech design meets desperate venture capital grift.

buffoon_delusion.what_bros_think: Accessing exclusive AI-powered brewery producing revolutionary beers designed by quantum algorithms
buffoon_delusion.what_actually_happening: Drinking mediocre lager while watching random number generators, paying premium for LED lights and buzzwords

core_mechanics.description: Choose 3 ingredients from randomized bizarre options (activated charcoal, pine resin, blockchain extract). Secret correct combination based on session seed. Wrong choices increase foam pressure meter. Explosion at 100%.
Floating cube covered in scrolling stock ticker buzzwords. Random status application (Grease Fingers, Thirsty, Inspired). Defeat when specific buzzword appears.
AI boss with foam projectile attacks, buzzword summons, self-destruct vulnerability. Defeat through combat OR console hacking mid-fight.

intro_cutscene.text: A robotic voice greets you: 'Welcome to the Brewvolution™ — your mouth is now under analysis.'

host_details.invitation: Bro... you just saved my algorithm... crash at my place while I rebuild...

satirical_subtitle: I Run On LimeWire And Vengeance

visual_design.exterior_description: No external signage. Hidden within Internet History Museum (gutted Blockbuster with dial-up modem shrine). GeoCities kiosk interaction at 3:33 AM triggers MSN Messenger terminal password prompt. ASCII cats peer from ductwork like cursed guardians. Faint Nokia ringtone loops from somewhere. Glitchy AIM away messages plaster museum walls.
visual_design.interior_description: RGB-lit den behind secret VHS shelf mechanism. Cramped back room aesthetic with flickering CRT glow bouncing off Funcoland bags and corrupted gifs. Desktop PC endlessly crashes into Windows 98 startup chime. Vintage computer equipment stacked as altar. AIM away message shrine with devotional lighting. Bleached tips wig stand with Guy Fieri visor. Baja Blast vape cloud constantly present. ASCII cats mounted in ductwork as guardians. Early 2000s tech ephemera creating shrine aesthetic. Smell of Hot Pockets and old carpet burns.

satirical_design.theme_description: Weaponized nostalgia manifested as underground economy. Early internet culture treated with religious reverence by someone who peaked in 2003. Memes as currency and identity. The smell of Hot Pockets and old carpet burns your soul just by existing in the space.

buffoon_delusion.what_bros_think: Accessing exclusive underground meme economy with rare digital artifacts
buffoon_delusion.what_actually_happening: Paying real money for psychological damage and items that literally do nothing

core_mechanics.description: Purchase meme summons that have chaotic effects in combat. Some help, most don't, psychological damage is real.
Equippable items providing passive bonuses with satirical drawbacks.
Track meme usage and nostalgia engagement to unlock rewards.

intro_cutscene.text: The VHS shelf slides open, revealing an RGB-lit shrine to digital degeneracy. A voice crackles through ancient speakers: 'Warning: I run on LimeWire and vengeance.'

satirical_subtitle: Preserving Our Digital Past (In Comic Sans)

visual_design.exterior_description: Still vaguely Blockbuster-shaped building wrapped in floppy disk boards and AOL caution tape. Comic Sans banner glitches 'PRESERVING OUR DIGITAL PAST' above entrance patched with jewel cases. Dead PalmPilot security camera, pigeons nesting on 404 Error sign.
visual_design.interior_description: Labyrinthine nostalgia maze with CRT monitors flickering vaporwave screensavers, dust motes dancing in static glow. Hall of Modems shrine, GeoCities diorama with twinkling stars, Angelfire wall stuck loading, Habbo crime scene, MSN graveyard, iMac G3 altar with incense.

satirical_design.theme_description: Weaponized nostalgia where Gen X and elder millennial digital trauma gets museum treatment. Less archive, more hallucination of what early internet was. Cursed yearbook for every regrettable digital moment between 1995-2007.
